title: Apiosk native European company source specifications

scope.deliverable: Source specifications and catalog files only, per user confirmation. No runtime source activated or deployed.
scope.research_boundary: Six public national APIs probed; other records identify documentation or required access work. Proposed capabilities are not proof of executable support.

terminology.native: Authority-published national registry or official national dataset; preserve the actual publisher. Official aggregations (ARES, DINUM) are labelled as derived indexes.
terminology.direct: Transport goes to the authority-operated endpoint. An authorised distributor may carry native data but is still an intermediary.
terminology.ready: Requires licence/access, tested adapter, accepted execution contract, explicit price, deployed route, successful execution and saved-result recovery. No new source in this specification is marked ready.
terminology.unknown: Not verified in this review; does not mean unavailable or free.

corrections_to_pasted_list: The current GLEIF v1.9 file is dated 30 September 2026: downloaded list has 1,181 rows and 234 nonempty country codes, including special and non-company authorities. It is registry metadata, not 1,181 usable company APIs.
BRIS is an interconnection/portal. A documented commercial machine-access contract is still required. EUID is an identifier, not a separate source.
VIES validates supplied VAT numbers; no general company-search or full VIES company dataset was established.
GLEIF Level 2 is accounting consolidation and may contain exceptions. It is not full shareholding or natural-person UBO.
Open Ownership Register closed 29 November 2024; current BODS datasets remain a separate integration option.
RIK reports EBR service closure from 1 April 2026. EBRA remains useful for registry discovery.
AJPES old wsPrsInfo SOAP was retired 28 February 2026; use restPrsInfo REST.
Sweden has a free HVD API distinct from paid company-information and restricted UBO services.
Iceland Public API v2 is deprecated; current listed product is v2.1.
Finland digital financial data covers iXBRL filings. Basic YTJ data does not imply financial PDFs, representation rights or all historical accounts.
National ID, tax ID, establishment ID and internal document ID must remain different schemes. Germany also requires registration court and register type.
